title: Rainy Day Rescue! Farm Animals Song | Thumpy Meadow
description_intro: H6 pilot (yukleme yok): four story-songs with Dino and friends.

hook.say: Oh no! The rain is coming!

lines: And in the rain he found a cow,
With a moo moo here and a moo moo there,
Here a moo, there a moo, everywhere a moo moo,
And in the rain he found a duck,
With a quack quack here and a quack quack there,
Here a quack, there a quack, everywhere a quack quack,
And in the mud he found a pig,
With a snort snort here and a snort snort there,
Here a snort, there a snort, everywhere a snort snort,
Now the farm is warm and dry,
The rain is gone, the sun is out,
With a hug hug here and a hug hug there,
Here a hug, there a hug, everywhere a hug hug,
Now the farm is warm and dry,
